scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=apps/api & npm run dev --workspace=apps/web
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build --workspace=apps/api && npm run build --workspace=apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:unit --workspace=packages/shared --if-present && npm run test:unit --workspace=apps/api --if-present && npm run test:unit --workspace=apps/web --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=packages/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/web
